title: A basilisk. E quando vede l’uomo l’attosca. Messer Brunetto, I thank thee for the word.
html_source:
Dante. Inferno, Canto 15.

http://lit.genius.com/3889709

Latini was a scholar and part of the Florentine establishment at the time Danté wrote the Inferno. In Canto 15, he meets Dante and discusses his future. Danté had a positive relationship with Latini in real life and paints a positive picture of him in the canto despite latini being in a ring of hell for sodomites, sodomy being non-intercourse sexual acts including homosexual acts.
